name: Caddock Electronics Inc
old_description: Caddock Electronics, Inc. manufactures precision resistors and resistor
about:
Caddock Electronics, Inc. is based in Roseburg, Oregon. The company manufactures precision resistors and resistor networks, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm produces over 250 standard models, including high-voltage resistors, current-sense resistors, chip resistors, high-frequency and RF resistors, load resistors, pulse resistors, and non-inductive power resistors. It also offers custom resistor and resistor-network solutions. Caddock employs proprietary resistance-film and process technologies to meet demanding performance requirements.

Caddock’s products are referenced for military and space applications, as indicated by dedicated sections on its website for those sectors. The company also notes compliance with REACH environmental regulations.

The company emphasizes its unique resistance-film and process technologies as the foundation for solving performance-critical challenges. Custom design capabilities and a broad catalog of high-stability, high-voltage parts further distinguish its offering.
